description: Source code implementing intra-node communication utilities for distributed GPU systems, including device topology detection, NVLink connectivity querying, and rendezvous procedures.

classes.name: IntraNodeComm
classes.description: Class managing intra-node GPU communication, including topology detection and rendezvous.

methods.name: getNvlMesh
methods.description: Queries NVLink connectivity among devices based on the system's configuration.

methods.name: detectTopology
methods.description: Determines the topology of devices based on NVLink connectivity matrix.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if intra-node communication is enabled based on configuration variables.

methods.name: storeAllGather
methods.description: Performs an all-gather operation using c10d::Store for trivially copyable types.

methods.name: rendezvous
methods.description: Performs rendezvous procedure to establish intra-node communication, including topology detection and resource allocation.
